summary: During this scheduling run, a total of 1281 passes were considered, with 289 successfully scheduled and 992 dropped. All 60 priority-1 passes were secured, while no priority-1 passes were discarded. Among the 992 dropped passes, 694 have potential alternatives later in the window, with a median wait time of 383.6 minutes. The remaining 298 dropped passes lack any viable alternatives within the planning window.
